result.stdout:
Description:
  Generate an index.html in a directory and each subdirectory.

Usage:
  directory-index [options]

Options:
  --folder <folder> (REQUIRED)  Root directory to index.
  --template <template>         Optional Scriban template file.
  -?, -h, --help                Show help and usage information
  --version                     Show version information
